\subsection*{1.\quad BFB-n is copositivity of $A$, and the closed-form $3\times3$ test is reliable where direction sampling is not}
\emph{derived here} --- \S2\par\medskip
\textbf{Independent checks}\begin{itemize}\itemsep0pt
\item copositive shown strictly weaker than positive semi-definite
\item closed form agrees with sampling on 3999 of 4000 random matrices
\item on the one disagreement the closed form is right --- the matrix has $A_{33}<0$ and is violated only near the $e_3$ axis
\end{itemize}
\textbf{Would be falsified by:} a matrix where the closed form passes but an exhibited $r\ge0$ gives $r^{\mathsf T}Ar<0$\par

\subsection*{2.\quad The lower-bound strategy: $V_4\ge V_N+V_{CB}^{\rm lower}+V_G^{\rm lower}$, reducing BFB to one $3\times3$ copositivity test}
\emph{imported} --- \S3 (from [BotoRomaoSilva22])\par\medskip
\textbf{Claim}\par\nopagebreak
\begin{equation*}\small \hat\lambda_{ij}=\lambda_{ij}+\min(0,\lambda'_{ij})-|\bar\lambda_{ij}|,\qquad \text{BFB} \Longleftarrow \hat\lambda \text{ copositive} \end{equation*}
\textbf{Independent checks}\begin{itemize}\itemsep0pt
\item $V_{\rm lower}\le V_4$ verified on $10^5$ random field configurations
\item the bound is attained, so step 2 is tight for either sign alone
\item flipping the sign in $\min(0,\lambda')$ breaks it
\end{itemize}
\textbf{Would be falsified by:} a field configuration with $V_4<V_{\rm lower}$\par
\medskip\hrule\medskip
\subsection*{3.\quad Our $V_4$ decomposes exactly into their $V_N+V_{CB}+V_G$ **plus** a remainder $\propto\lambda_4$ whose monomial shapes occur nowhere in their framework}

\begin{equation*}\small V_{\rm rest}=2\lambda_4\big[\mathrm{Re}(x_{1S})(r_1-r_2)-2\,\mathrm{Re}(x_{2S})\,\mathrm{Re}(x_{12})\big] \end{equation*}
\textbf{Independent checks}\begin{itemize}\itemsep0pt
